profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at UL Solutions
profile.summary:
I am a senior software engineer at UL Solutions on the Base Platform team developing .NET applications as part of the Fellowship team. I also 
work with Microsoft Azure supporting infrastructure primarily in regards to Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, and web applications. I am fully remote and have the privilege of working with colleagues primarily in the UK but elsewhere as well. 

When I was at Ace Hardware Corporation I utilized my experience by building complex web-based applications and providing mentorship to junior software engineers with a willingness to learn new skills and grow as a leader. 

Proficient in building ASP.NET web applications in MVC and Web Forms in both Agile and Waterfall development lifecycles. 

Implement WCF SOAP and Web Api web services that connect to and get data from various middleware and backend systems: SQL, SAP, Teradata, WebSphere Message Broker, Informatica, Solr, Linux

Technical skills: C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, Web Api, Razor, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, Entity Framework, SQL, Test Driven Development 

Masters of Science in Computer Science from Northern Illinois University

positions.title: Software Engineer Analyst 2
positions.description:
Tech Lead with business analyst duties responsible for providing leadership and guidance to project development team on numerous projects with ACENET and point-of-sale vendor touch-points

Member of point-of-sale support team working with vendors, internal Ace teams, and retailers to address concerns and provide details on sending data to Ace and retrieving data from Ace

Worked closely with Tech Lead and another senior software engineer by splitting up main SEO (Search-Evaluate-Order) TFS team project into individual components and micro-services on Ace’s internal business-to-business site, ACENET.

Continue to work closely with business partners in Agile and Waterfall SDLCs to deliver quality solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer Analyst 1
positions.description:
Piloted ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and Web Api, and utilized Entity Framework and Telerik’s Kendo components for ASP.NET, when building an order tracking app on Ace’s internal B2B site, ACENET. 

Tech lead in transitioning customer survey experience from Market Force to Gallup-Medallia. 

Helped rearchitect & redesign important event planner web application used primarily during biannual Ace convention, moving from reliance on SAP to instead get data from SQL. 

Took 4-day training course on Test Driven Development in January 2021

positions.title: Software Enginnering Associate 2
positions.description: Converted Sharepoint hosted environment into an ASP.NET hosted environment, utilizing MVC, Razor, and Web Api. Played a key role in redesigning most visited SEO app on Ace’s internal B2B retailer facing website. Implemented Google Analytics in key, heavily used apps to understand user behavior and site usage. Continued to build, enhance, and support vital SEO ASP.NET applications on ACENET.

positions.title: Software Engineering Associate I
positions.description: Fixed defects and implemented enhancements to ASP.NET Web Forms apps and WCF SOAP web services. Enhanced an application for managing defective goods using the Telerik RadGrid. Replaced Sharepoint FAST search with Apache Solr Search and an ASP.NET search application on Ace’s B2B retailer facing website, ACENET, while piloting Agile Scrum methodology.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
I was an active member of a software development team building a Content Management System for one of the world's biggest financial services institutions. This system delivered formatted transactions notifications via SMS and E-mail to end customers. My role was to prototype, build, and test various parts of a web interface in HTML/CSS/JS, and also to build back-end server components in PHP/MySQL operating in a Linux run-time environment. Additionally, I built a back-end PHP/C++ library utility that was used to parse XML files.

Languages used: C++, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MySQL

positions.title: Seasonal Program Leader
positions.locationName: Prairieview Education Center, Crystal Lake, IL

positions.title: Seasonal Program Leader
positions.locationName: Prairieview Education Center, Crystal Lake, IL
positions.description: I planned and, with 3 other counselors, led a variety of summer camps for the McHenry County Conservation District, which included activities such as orienteering, team building exercises, canoeing, fishing, fire starting with flint and steel, hiking, and encouraged an appreciation of the natural environment and history of McHenry County through education, recreation, and preservation.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Designed promotional market designs, business cards, and a template for a website in Joomla, a popular CMS.

positions.title: Temp. Employee
positions.description:
In charge of processing web orders, as well as cashier; stocking books; customer service; and working with confidential information.

— December 2013 & January 2014
— January 2013
— August 2012
— January 2012
— March 2011 to August 30, 2011
— Summer 2009 and Winter Breaks 2008, 2009, & 2010

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I was an intern at Star 105.5 and Y 103.9 FM radio stations, housed in one building. I worked in the Promotions Department, and as well as graphic design work, I also participated in charity events and other community events, such as a fundraiser for a non-profit or parades. I enjoyed my time there, and wish that they had a graphic design position available.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
I also worked as a temporary worker the Summers of 2009 and 2011, and Winter Breaks 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2011

My responsibilities included: Cashier; Stocking books; Customer Service; Working with confidential information; Inventory, Handling and processing web orders
